question: How many daughter cells are formed from one parent cell at the end of meiosis?

question: The glucose units in a cellulose molecule are joined by

question: The light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis take place on the
question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषणका प्रकाश-निर्भर अभिक्रियाहरू कहाँ हुन्छन्?

explanation_ne: थाइलाकोइड झिल्लीमा क्लोरोफिल र फोटोसिस्टम हुन्छन्, त्यसैले प्रकाश अभिक्रिया त्यहाँ हुन्छन्, जबकि अन्धकार अभिक्रिया स्ट्रोमामा हुन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which pigment present in the thylakoid membrane absorbs light energy most strongly in the blue and red regions?
question_ne: थाइलाकोइड झिल्लीमा रहेको कुन रङ्गद्रव्यले नीलो र रातो क्षेत्रमा प्रकाश ऊर्जा सबैभन्दा बलियो गरी सोस्छ?
explanation: Chlorophyll absorbs mainly blue and red light and reflects green light, which is why leaves look green.
explanation_ne: क्लोरोफिलले मुख्य रूपमा नीलो र रातो प्रकाश सोस्छ र हरियो प्रकाश परावर्तित गर्छ, त्यसैले पातहरू हरिया देखिन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The fluid-filled space surrounding the thylakoids inside a chloroplast is the
question_ne: हरितकणभित्र थाइलाकोइड वरिपरिको तरल पदार्थले भरिएको ठाउँ कुन हो?
explanation: The stroma is the fluid matrix of the chloroplast surrounding the grana, where the Calvin cycle (dark reactions) takes place.
explanation_ne: स्ट्रोमा हरितकणको तरल म्याट्रिक्स हो जसले ग्रानालाई घेर्छ, जहाँ क्याल्भिन चक्र (अन्धकार अभिक्रिया) हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which organelle is the powerhouse of the cell, producing most of its ATP?
question_ne: कुन कोशिकाअङ्ग कोशिकाको ऊर्जा गृह हो, जसले धेरैजसो ATP बनाउँछ?
explanation: Mitochondria carry out aerobic respiration, releasing energy from glucose to form ATP.
explanation_ne: माइटोकन्ड्रियाले वायवीय श्वसन गर्छ र ग्लुकोजबाट ऊर्जा निकालेर ATP बनाउँछ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The control centre of the cell, which contains the chromosomes, is the
question_ne: क्रोमोजोम भएको कोशिकाको नियन्त्रण केन्द्र कुन हो?
explanation: The nucleus contains the chromosomes and controls the activities of the cell, including growth and reproduction.
explanation_ne: केन्द्रकमा क्रोमोजोम हुन्छन् र यसले वृद्धि र प्रजननसहित कोशिकाका गतिविधिहरू नियन्त्रण गर्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which organelle is the site of protein synthesis in the cell?
question_ne: कोशिकामा प्रोटिन संश्लेषण हुने ठाउँ कुन हो?
explanation: Ribosomes join amino acids together to build proteins, either free in the cytoplasm or attached to the endoplasmic reticulum.
explanation_ne: राइबोसोमले एमिनो अम्लहरूलाई जोडेर प्रोटिन बनाउँछ, कोशिकाद्रव्यमा स्वतन्त्र रूपमा वा अन्तःप्रद्रव्यी जालिकामा टाँसिएर।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The large central vacuole of a mature plant cell is filled with
question_ne: परिपक्व वनस्पति कोशिकाको ठूलो केन्द्रीय रिक्तिका केले भरिएको हुन्छ?
explanation: The central vacuole is filled with cell sap, a watery solution of salts, sugars, pigments and waste products.
explanation_ne: केन्द्रीय रिक्तिका कोशिका रसले भरिएको हुन्छ, जुन लवण, चिनी, रङ्गद्रव्य र फोहोर पदार्थको पानीयुक्त घोल हो।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which structure allows the exchange of materials between adjacent plant cells through the cell wall?
question_ne: कुन संरचनाले छेउछेउका वनस्पति कोशिकाहरूबीच कोशिका भित्ताबाट पदार्थ आदानप्रदान गर्न दिन्छ?
explanation: Plasmodesmata are tiny cytoplasmic channels through the cell wall that connect neighbouring plant cells.
explanation_ne: प्लाज्मोडेस्माटा कोशिका भित्ताबाट जाने साना कोशिकाद्रव्यीय नली हुन् जसले छेउछेउका वनस्पति कोशिकाहरूलाई जोड्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Mitosis produces two daughter cells that are genetically
question_ne: समसूत्री विभाजनबाट बन्ने दुई छोरी कोशिका आनुवंशिक रूपमा कस्ता हुन्छन्?
explanation: Mitosis copies the chromosomes exactly, so each daughter cell receives the same number and kind of chromosomes as the parent cell.
explanation_ne: समसूत्री विभाजनमा क्रोमोजोमहरू ठ्याक्कै नक्कल हुन्छन्, त्यसैले प्रत्येक छोरी कोशिकाले मातृ कोशिकाकै बराबर र उस्तै क्रोमोजोम पाउँछ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: During which stage of mitosis do sister chromatids separate and move to opposite poles?
question_ne: समसूत्री विभाजनको कुन अवस्थामा सिस्टर क्रोमाटिडहरू अलग भएर विपरीत ध्रुवतिर जान्छन्?
explanation: In anaphase, the centromere splits and sister chromatids are pulled apart to opposite poles by spindle fibres.
explanation_ne: एनाफेजमा सेन्ट्रोमियर फुट्छ र सिस्टर क्रोमाटिडहरू स्पिन्डल तन्तुले तानेर विपरीत ध्रुवतिर जान्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: In a plant, mitosis mainly takes place in
question_ne: बिरुवामा समसूत्री विभाजन मुख्य रूपमा कहाँ हुन्छ?
explanation: Meristematic tissues, such as root tips and shoot tips, contain actively dividing cells that grow by mitosis.
explanation_ne: जरा र काण्डका टुप्पा जस्ता विभज्योतक ऊतकमा सक्रिय रूपमा विभाजन हुने कोशिका हुन्छन् जुन समसूत्री विभाजनद्वारा बढ्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The stage of mitosis in which chromosomes line up along the equator of the cell is
question_ne: समसूत्री विभाजनको कुन अवस्थामा क्रोमोजोमहरू कोशिकाको मध्य रेखामा लाइन लाग्छन्?
explanation: In metaphase, chromosomes arrange themselves on the equatorial plate, attached to spindle fibres at their centromeres.
explanation_ne: मेटाफेजमा क्रोमोजोमहरू मध्य रेखामा व्यवस्थित हुन्छन् र आफ्नो सेन्ट्रोमियरमा स्पिन्डल तन्तुसँग जोडिएका हुन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: In plant cells, the new cell wall between the two daughter nuclei is formed from the
question_ne: वनस्पति कोशिकामा दुई छोरी केन्द्रकबीच नयाँ कोशिका भित्ता कुनबाट बन्छ?
explanation: Plant cells cannot pinch in two, so Golgi vesicles fuse at the equator to form a cell plate that grows into the new cell wall.
explanation_ne: वनस्पति कोशिका दुई भागमा च्यापिन सक्दैन, त्यसैले गोल्जी थैलीहरू मध्य रेखामा मिलेर कोशिका प्लेट बनाउँछन् जुन नयाँ कोशिका भित्ता बन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The raw materials required for photosynthesis are
question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषणका लागि चाहिने कच्चा पदार्थ कुन हुन्?
explanation: Green plants use carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil, with sunlight energy, to make glucose and release oxygen.
explanation_ne: हरिया बिरुवाले हावाबाट कार्बन डाइअक्साइड र माटोबाट पानी लिएर सूर्यको प्रकाश ऊर्जाले ग्लुकोज बनाउँछन् र अक्सिजन निकाल्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Oxygen released during photosynthesis comes from the splitting of
question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषणमा निस्कने अक्सिजन कुनको विभाजनबाट आउँछ?
explanation: During the light reactions, water molecules are split (photolysis), releasing oxygen, protons and electrons.
explanation_ne: प्रकाश अभिक्रियामा पानीका अणुहरू विभाजित हुन्छन् (फोटोलाइसिस), जसले अक्सिजन, प्रोटोन र इलेक्ट्रोन निकाल्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The dark reactions (Calvin cycle) of photosynthesis take place in the
question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषणका अन्धकार अभिक्रिया (क्याल्भिन चक्र) कहाँ हुन्छन्?
explanation: The Calvin cycle fixes carbon dioxide into sugar in the stroma of the chloroplast, using ATP and NADPH from the light reactions.
explanation_ne: क्याल्भिन चक्रले हरितकणको स्ट्रोमामा प्रकाश अभिक्रियाबाट आएको ATP र NADPH प्रयोग गरी कार्बन डाइअक्साइडलाई चिनीमा बदल्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which of the following is the first stable product of the Calvin cycle?
question_ne: निम्नमध्ये क्याल्भिन चक्रको पहिलो स्थिर उत्पादन कुन हो?
explanation: Carbon dioxide first combines with RuBP to form an unstable compound that splits into two molecules of 3-PGA, the first stable product.
explanation_ne: कार्बन डाइअक्साइड पहिले RuBP सँग मिलेर अस्थिर यौगिक बनाउँछ जुन फुटेर ३-PGA का दुई अणु बन्छन्, जुन पहिलो स्थिर उत्पादन हो।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The light reactions of photosynthesis produce ATP and NADPH, which are used in the
question_ne: प्रकाश संश्लेषणका प्रकाश अभिक्रियाबाट बन्ने ATP र NADPH कुनमा प्रयोग हुन्छन्?
explanation: ATP and NADPH made in the light reactions provide the energy and reducing power for the Calvin cycle to fix carbon dioxide into sugar.
explanation_ne: प्रकाश अभिक्रियामा बनेका ATP र NADPH ले क्याल्भिन चक्रलाई कार्बन डाइअक्साइडलाई चिनीमा बदल्न ऊर्जा र घटाउने शक्ति दिन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The first stage of cellular respiration, glycolysis, takes place in the
question_ne: कोशिकीय श्वसनको पहिलो चरण ग्लाइकोलाइसिस कहाँ हुन्छ?
explanation: Glycolysis occurs in the cytoplasm, where glucose is broken down into pyruvic acid without needing oxygen.
explanation_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिस कोशिकाद्रव्यमा हुन्छ, जहाँ ग्लुकोज अक्सिजन बिना पाइरुभिक अम्लमा टुक्रिन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The end product of glycolysis is
question_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिसको अन्तिम उत्पादन के हो?
explanation: Each glucose molecule is split during glycolysis into two molecules of pyruvic acid (pyruvate).
explanation_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिसमा प्रत्येक ग्लुकोज अणु फुटेर पाइरुभिक अम्ल (पाइरुभेट) का दुई अणु बन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The Krebs cycle takes place in the
question_ne: क्रेब्स चक्र कहाँ हुन्छ?
explanation: The Krebs cycle (citric acid cycle) occurs in the mitochondrial matrix, where acetyl CoA is fully oxidised to carbon dioxide.
explanation_ne: क्रेब्स चक्र (साइट्रिक अम्ल चक्र) माइटोकन्ड्रियल म्याट्रिक्समा हुन्छ, जहाँ एसिटिल CoA पूर्ण रूपमा अक्सिडाइज भएर कार्बन डाइअक्साइड बन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: How many ATP molecules are gained (net) from one glucose molecule during glycolysis?
question_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिसमा एउटा ग्लुकोज अणुबाट खुद कति ATP अणु प्राप्त हुन्छ?
explanation: Glycolysis produces 4 ATP but uses 2 ATP at the start, giving a net gain of 2 ATP per glucose molecule.
explanation_ne: ग्लाइकोलाइसिसमा ४ ATP बन्छ तर सुरुमा २ ATP खर्च हुन्छ, त्यसैले प्रति ग्लुकोज अणु खुद २ ATP प्राप्त हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: During anaerobic respiration in yeast, pyruvic acid is converted into
question_ne: यिस्टमा अवायवीय श्वसन हुँदा पाइरुभिक अम्ल केमा परिणत हुन्छ?
explanation: In yeast fermentation, pyruvic acid is converted into ethanol and carbon dioxide in the absence of oxygen.
explanation_ne: यिस्टको किण्वनमा अक्सिजनको अभावमा पाइरुभिक अम्ल इथेनोल र कार्बन डाइअक्साइडमा परिणत हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Xylem tissue in plants mainly conducts
question_ne: बिरुवामा जाइलम ऊतकले मुख्य रूपमा के ओसार्छ?
explanation: Xylem vessels carry water and dissolved minerals upward from the roots to the leaves and other parts of the plant.
explanation_ne: जाइलम भेसेलले पानी र घुलेका खनिजलाई जराबाट माथि पात र बिरुवाका अन्य भागमा पुर्‍याउँछ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Phloem tissue in plants mainly conducts
question_ne: बिरुवामा फ्लोएम ऊतकले मुख्य रूपमा के ओसार्छ?
explanation: Phloem sieve tubes transport sugars made in the leaves to growing and storage parts of the plant.
explanation_ne: फ्लोएम चालनी नलिकाले पातमा बनेको चिनीलाई बिरुवाका बढ्दै गरेका र भण्डारण हुने भागमा पुर्‍याउँछ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The tissue that gives mechanical strength to plants and is made of thick-walled dead cells is
question_ne: बाक्लो भित्ता भएका मृत कोशिकाबाट बनेको र बिरुवालाई यान्त्रिक बल दिने ऊतक कुन हो?
explanation: Sclerenchyma cells have thick lignified walls and are dead at maturity, providing strength and support to the plant.
explanation_ne: स्क्लेरेन्काइमा कोशिकाका भित्ता बाक्ला र लिग्निनयुक्त हुन्छन् र परिपक्व हुँदा मृत हुन्छन्, जसले बिरुवालाई बल र आधार दिन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The outermost layer of cells covering the root, stem and leaves of a plant is the
question_ne: बिरुवाको जरा, काण्ड र पात ढाक्ने सबैभन्दा बाहिरी कोशिका तह कुन हो?
explanation: The epidermis is a single layer of protective cells covering the outer surface of roots, stems and leaves.
explanation_ne: बाह्यत्वचा जरा, काण्ड र पातको बाहिरी सतह ढाक्ने सुरक्षात्मक कोशिकाको एउटै तह हो।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: In a dicot stem, the vascular bundles are arranged in a
question_ne: द्विबीजपत्री काण्डमा संवहन बन्डलहरू कसरी व्यवस्थित हुन्छन्?
explanation: In a dicot stem, vascular bundles form a ring around the central pith, unlike monocot stems where they are scattered.
explanation_ne: द्विबीजपत्री काण्डमा संवहन बन्डलहरू केन्द्रीय पिथ वरिपरि औँठी आकारमा हुन्छन्, जबकि एकबीजपत्री काण्डमा तिनीहरू छरिएका हुन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The plant hormone that promotes the elongation of shoots and roots is
question_ne: काण्ड र जराको लम्बाइ बढाउने वनस्पति हर्मोन कुन हो?
explanation: Auxin promotes cell elongation in shoots and roots and is produced mainly in shoot tips.
explanation_ne: अक्सिनले काण्ड र जरामा कोशिका लम्ब्याउन बढावा दिन्छ र मुख्य रूपमा काण्डको टुप्पामा बन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which plant hormone promotes cell division and delays the ageing of leaves?
question_ne: कुन वनस्पति हर्मोनले कोशिका विभाजन बढाउँछ र पात बूढो हुन ढिलाइ गर्छ?
explanation: Cytokinins stimulate cell division and delay leaf senescence (ageing) by keeping the cells active.
explanation_ne: साइटोकाइनिनले कोशिका विभाजन बढाउँछ र कोशिकालाई सक्रिय राखेर पात बूढो हुन ढिलाइ गर्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The ripening of fruits is promoted by the hormone
question_ne: फल पाक्ने प्रक्रियालाई कुन हर्मोनले बढावा दिन्छ?
explanation: Ethylene is a gaseous hormone that speeds up fruit ripening and is used commercially to ripen fruits such as bananas.
explanation_ne: इथिलिन ग्यासीय हर्मोन हो जसले फल पाक्ने गति बढाउँछ र केरा जस्ता फल पकाउन व्यावसायिक रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Gibberellins are mainly responsible for
question_ne: जिबरेलिन मुख्य रूपमा कुन कार्यका लागि जिम्मेवार हुन्छ?
options: Breaking seed dormancy and stem elongation
options_ne: बीजको सुप्तावस्था तोड्न र काण्ड लम्ब्याउन
explanation: Gibberellins break seed dormancy, promote germination and cause stem elongation, especially in dwarf plants.
explanation_ne: जिबरेलिनले बीजको सुप्तावस्था तोड्छ, अङ्कुरण बढाउँछ र विशेष गरी होचा बिरुवामा काण्ड लम्ब्याउँछ।

question: A dominant allele is one that expresses its trait in the organism even when present in

question: In Mendel's pea plants, tallness of the stem is dominant over dwarfness. The F1 offspring of a cross between pure tall and pure dwarf plants are all

question: A pea plant showing the dominant tall phenotype may have which of the following genotypes?

question: Which statement about a dominant trait is correct?

question: The pyramid of numbers in a grassland ecosystem is

question: Which ecological pyramid is always upright in every type of ecosystem?

question: The two main gases responsible for acid rain are

question: In plant tissue culture, a callus is
question_ne: वनस्पति ऊतक संवर्धनमा क्यालस भनेको के हो?
options: An unorganised mass of undifferentiated cells
A seed with a hard coat
explanation: A callus is an unorganised, actively dividing mass of undifferentiated parenchyma cells grown from an explant.
explanation_ne: क्यालस भनेको एक्सप्लान्टबाट हुर्काइएको असङ्गठित, सक्रिय रूपमा विभाजन हुने अविभेदित कोषहरूको समूह हो।

question: A callus usually develops from a piece of plant tissue placed on a nutrient medium. This starting piece of tissue is
question_ne: पोषक माध्यममा राखिएको वनस्पति ऊतकको टुक्राबाट सामान्यतया क्यालस विकास हुन्छ। यो सुरुको ऊतकको टुक्रालाई के भनिन्छ?

question: Under suitable hormonal conditions, cells of a callus can differentiate to form shoots and roots. This process of forming new organs is
question_ne: उपयुक्त हर्मोन अवस्थामा क्यालसका कोषहरू विभेदित भई काण्ड र जरा बनाउन सक्छन्। नयाँ अङ्गहरू बन्ने यो प्रक्रियालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Organogenesis is the development of shoots or roots from undifferentiated callus cells under the influence of growth regulators.
explanation_ne: अङ्गजनन भनेको वृद्धि नियामकहरूको प्रभावमा अविभेदित क्यालस कोषहरूबाट काण्ड वा जरा विकास हुने प्रक्रिया हो।

question: In tissue culture, a high auxin-to-cytokinin ratio in the medium generally promotes the formation of
question_ne: ऊतक संवर्धनमा माध्यममा अक्सिन र साइटोकाइनिनको उच्च अनुपातले सामान्यतया कुन अङ्ग बन्न प्रोत्साहन गर्छ?
explanation: A high auxin-to-cytokinin ratio favours root formation, while a high cytokinin-to-auxin ratio favours shoot formation.
explanation_ne: अक्सिन र साइटोकाइनिनको उच्च अनुपातले जरा बन्न सहयोग गर्छ भने साइटोकाइनिनको उच्च अनुपातले काण्ड बन्न सहयोग गर्छ।

question: Callus culture is useful in agriculture and industry mainly because it allows
question_ne: क्यालस संवर्धन कृषि र उद्योगमा मुख्यतया किन उपयोगी छ?
options: Rapid large-scale production of genetically uniform plants
Growth of plants without any water
Direct conversion of leaves into fruits
options_ne: आनुवंशिक रूपमा समान बिरुवाहरूको छिटो ठूलो मात्रामा उत्पादन
explanation: Plants regenerated from a callus are clones of the parent, so callus culture gives fast, large-scale micropropagation of uniform plants.
explanation_ne: क्यालसबाट पुनर्जीवित बिरुवाहरू जनकका क्लोन हुन्, त्यसैले क्यालस संवर्धनबाट समान बिरुवाहरूको छिटो ठूलो मात्रामा सूक्ष्म प्रसारण हुन्छ।

question: Rhizobium bacteria, used as a biofertilizer for legume crops, live in the
question_ne: दलहन बालीका लागि जैविक मलका रूपमा प्रयोग हुने राइजोबियम जीवाणु कहाँ बस्छन्?
explanation: Rhizobium lives symbiotically in the root nodules of legumes, where it fixes atmospheric nitrogen for the plant.
explanation_ne: राइजोबियम दलहन बालीका जराका गाँठाहरूमा सहजीवी रूपमा बस्छ र वायुमण्डलीय नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण गरी बिरुवालाई दिन्छ।

question: The Azolla-Anabaena association is widely used as a biofertilizer in the cultivation of
question_ne: एजोला-एनाबिना सङ्गठन कुन बालीको खेतीमा जैविक मलका रूपमा व्यापक रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: Azolla is a water fern hosting nitrogen-fixing Anabaena, and it is applied to flooded paddy fields to enrich the soil with nitrogen.
explanation_ne: एजोला पानीमा हुने उन्यु हो जसमा नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण गर्ने एनाबिना बस्छ र यसलाई धान खेतमा नाइट्रोजन बढाउन प्रयोग गरिन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The main benefit that nitrogen-fixing biofertilizers give to crops is that they
question_ne: नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण गर्ने जैविक मलले बालीहरूलाई दिने मुख्य फाइदा के हो?
options: Convert atmospheric nitrogen into a form plants can use
options_ne: वायुमण्डलीय नाइट्रोजनलाई बिरुवाले प्रयोग गर्न सक्ने रूपमा बदल्नु
explanation: Nitrogen-fixing microbes convert inert atmospheric nitrogen gas into ammonia and other compounds that plants can absorb.
explanation_ne: नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण गर्ने सूक्ष्मजीवहरूले निष्क्रिय वायुमण्डलीय नाइट्रोजन ग्याँसलाई अमोनिया र बिरुवाले सोस्न सक्ने यौगिकहरूमा बदल्छन्।

question: Free-living blue-green algae such as Nostoc and Anabaena are useful as biofertilizers because they
question_ne: नोस्टोक र एनाबिनाजस्ता स्वतन्त्र नीलो-हरियो शैवाल जैविक मलका रूपमा किन उपयोगी छन्?
options: Fix atmospheric nitrogen in the soil
Eat harmful fungi in the soil
explanation: Many cyanobacteria fix atmospheric nitrogen in their heterocysts, adding usable nitrogen to the soil, especially in rice fields.
explanation_ne: धेरै साइनोब्याक्टेरियाले आफ्ना हेटेरोसिस्टमा वायुमण्डलीय नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण गर्छन् र माटोमा प्रयोगयोग्य नाइट्रोजन थप्छन्, विशेष गरी धान खेतमा।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Compared with chemical fertilizers, the main advantage of biofertilizers is that they
question_ne: रासायनिक मलको तुलनामा जैविक मलको मुख्य फाइदा के हो?
options: Are eco-friendly and improve long-term soil health
options_ne: वातावरणमैत्री छन् र दीर्घकालीन माटोको स्वास्थ्य सुधार्छन्
explanation: Biofertilizers are living organisms that enrich the soil naturally without polluting water or degrading soil structure, unlike excess chemical fertilizers.
explanation_ne: जैविक मल जीवित जीवहरू हुन् जसले पानी प्रदूषित नगरी र माटोको संरचना नबिगारी प्राकृतिक रूपमा माटोलाई समृद्ध बनाउँछन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Gregor Mendel carried out his famous heredity experiments using which plant?
question_ne: ग्रेगर मेन्डेलले आफ्ना प्रसिद्ध वंशानुगत प्रयोगहरू कुन बिरुवा प्रयोग गरेर गरे?
explanation: Mendel used the garden pea (Pisum sativum) because it has clear contrasting traits, self-pollinates, and grows quickly.
explanation_ne: मेन्डेलले केराउ (पाइसम स्याटाइभम) प्रयोग गरे किनभने यसमा स्पष्ट विपरीत लक्षणहरू हुन्छन्, स्वपरागण हुन्छ र छिटो हुर्कन्छ।

question: In a monohybrid cross between two heterozygous tall pea plants (Tt x Tt), the expected F2 phenotypic ratio is
question_ne: दुईवटा विषमयुग्मजी अग्ला केराउ (Tt x Tt) बीचको एकगुणी सङ्करणमा अपेक्षित F2 लक्षणात्मक अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation: The cross gives TT, Tt, Tt and tt offspring, so three quarters are tall and one quarter is dwarf, a 3 : 1 ratio.
explanation_ne: यो सङ्करणबाट TT, Tt, Tt र tt सन्तान बन्छन्, त्यसैले तीन चौथाइ अग्ला र एक चौथाइ होचा हुन्छन्, अर्थात् ३ : १ अनुपात।

question: Mendel's law of independent assortment applies to genes that are located on
question_ne: मेन्डेलको स्वतन्त्र वर्गीकरणको नियम कुन जीनहरूमा लागू हुन्छ?
options: The same chromosome far apart only
Different chromosomes, or far apart on the same chromosome
options_ne: फरक क्रोमोजोममा, वा एउटै क्रोमोजोममा टाढा रहेका
explanation: Independent assortment holds for genes on different chromosomes, or far apart on the same chromosome so that crossing over separates them; closely linked genes do not assort independently.
explanation_ne: स्वतन्त्र वर्गीकरण फरक क्रोमोजोममा रहेका वा एउटै क्रोमोजोममा टाढा रहेका जीनहरूमा लागू हुन्छ; नजिकै जोडिएका जीनहरू स्वतन्त्र रूपमा वर्गीकरण हुँदैनन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The law of segregation states that the two alleles of a gene separate from each other during
question_ne: पृथक्करणको नियमले के भन्छ भने एउटा जीनका दुई एलीलहरू कहिले एकअर्काबाट अलग हुन्छन्?
explanation: During gamete formation the two alleles of each gene separate, so each gamete carries only one allele.
explanation_ne: युग्मक निर्माणका क्रममा प्रत्येक जीनका दुई एलील अलग हुन्छन्, त्यसैले प्रत्येक युग्मकमा एउटा मात्र एलील हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: In Mendel's dihybrid cross of pea plants, the F2 phenotypic ratio obtained was
question_ne: केराउको द्विगुणी सङ्करणमा मेन्डेलले प्राप्त गरेको F2 लक्षणात्मक अनुपात कति थियो?
explanation: The dihybrid cross gives 9 both-dominant : 3 one-dominant : 3 other-dominant : 1 both-recessive, the classic 9 : 3 : 3 : 1 ratio.
explanation_ne: द्विगुणी सङ्करणबाट ९ दुवै प्रभावी : ३ एउटा प्रभावी : ३ अर्को प्रभावी : १ दुवै अप्रभावी अर्थात् ९ : ३ : ३ : १ अनुपात प्राप्त हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Two genes located close together on the same chromosome tend to be inherited together. This phenomenon is
question_ne: एउटै क्रोमोजोममा नजिकै रहेका दुई जीनहरू सँगै वंशानुगत हुने प्रवृत्ति हुन्छ। यो घटनालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Linkage is the tendency of genes on the same chromosome to stay together during inheritance, so they do not assort independently.
explanation_ne: सहलग्नता भनेको एउटै क्रोमोजोममा रहेका जीनहरू वंशानुगत हुँदा सँगै रहने प्रवृत्ति हो, जसले गर्दा तिनीहरू स्वतन्त्र रूपमा वर्गीकरण हुँदैनन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Crossing over between homologous chromosomes results in
question_ne: समजात क्रोमोजोमहरूबीच हुने क्रसिङ ओभरको परिणाम के हुन्छ?
options: New combinations of alleles in the gametes
explanation: Crossing over exchanges segments between homologous chromosomes, producing recombinant gametes with new allele combinations.
explanation_ne: क्रसिङ ओभरले समजात क्रोमोजोमहरूबीच खण्डहरू साटासाट गर्छ, जसले नयाँ एलील संयोजन भएका पुनर्संयोजित युग्मकहरू बन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: A mutation is best described as
question_ne: उत्परिवर्तनलाई सबैभन्दा राम्रोसँग कसरी वर्णन गर्न सकिन्छ?
options: A temporary change in phenotype due to the environment
The exchange of segments between chromosomes
A sudden heritable change in the genetic material
options_ne: वातावरणका कारण लक्षणमा हुने अस्थायी परिवर्तन
आनुवंशिक पदार्थमा हुने अचानक वंशानुगत परिवर्तन
explanation: A mutation is a sudden, heritable change in the DNA sequence, which may arise spontaneously or be induced by mutagens.
explanation_ne: उत्परिवर्तन भनेको DNA अनुक्रममा हुने अचानक वंशानुगत परिवर्तन हो, जुन आफैँ वा उत्परिवर्तकहरूको प्रभावले हुन सक्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a flower is
question_ne: फूलको परागकोषबाट वर्तिकाग्रसम्म परागकणहरूको स्थानान्तरणलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Pollination is the transfer of pollen from anther to stigma; fertilisation follows later when the male gamete fuses with the egg.
explanation_ne: परागण भनेको परागकोषबाट वर्तिकाग्रसम्म पराग स्थानान्तरण हो; निषेचन पछि हुन्छ जब नर युग्मक अण्डासँग मिल्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: When pollen from a flower lands on the stigma of another flower of a different plant of the same species, the process is
question_ne: एउटा फूलको पराग सोही प्रजातिको अर्को बिरुवाको फूलको वर्तिकाग्रमा पर्दा त्यो प्रक्रिया के हो?
explanation: Cross-pollination is the transfer of pollen between flowers of different plants of the same species.
explanation_ne: परपरागण भनेको एउटै प्रजातिका फरक बिरुवाका फूलहरूबीच पराग स्थानान्तरण हो।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The main advantage of cross-pollination over self-pollination is that it
question_ne: स्वपरागणको तुलनामा परपरागणको मुख्य फाइदा के हो?
options_ne: आनुवंशिक रूपमा विविध सन्तान उत्पादन गर्छ
explanation: Cross-pollination combines genes from two different plants, creating genetic variation that helps adaptation and vigour.
explanation_ne: परपरागणले दुई फरक बिरुवाका जीनहरू मिलाउँछ, जसले आनुवंशिक विविधता सिर्जना गर्छ र अनुकूलनमा मद्दत गर्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: In flowering plants, double fertilisation means that
question_ne: फूल फुल्ने वनस्पतिमा दोहोरो निषेचन भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
options: One male gamete fuses with the egg and the other with the two polar nuclei
Two pollen grains fertilise two different ovules
The same egg is fertilised twice
Fertilisation happens in two different flowers
options_ne: एउटा नर युग्मक अण्डासँग र अर्को दुई ध्रुवीय केन्द्रकसँग मिल्छ
दुई परागकणले दुई फरक बीजाण्डलाई निषेचित गर्छन्
एउटै अण्डा दुई पटक निषेचित हुन्छ
explanation: In double fertilisation, one sperm fuses with the egg to form the zygote and the second fuses with the polar nuclei to form the triploid endosperm.
explanation_ne: दोहोरो निषेचनमा एउटा शुक्राणु अण्डासँग मिलेर युग्मनज बनाउँछ र दोस्रो ध्रुवीय केन्द्रकसँग मिलेर त्रिगुणित भ्रूणपोष बनाउँछ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The endosperm of a flowering plant is triploid (3n) because it develops from the fusion of
question_ne: फूल फुल्ने वनस्पतिको भ्रूणपोष त्रिगुणित (3n) हुन्छ किनभने यो कुन संयोजनबाट विकास हुन्छ?
options: One haploid sperm with one haploid egg
Two haploid sperms with one haploid egg
One diploid sperm with one haploid polar nucleus
One haploid sperm with two haploid polar nuclei
options_ne: एउटा अगुणित शुक्राणु र एउटा अगुणित अण्डा
दुई अगुणित शुक्राणु र एउटा अगुणित अण्डा
एउटा द्विगुणित शुक्राणु र एउटा अगुणित ध्रुवीय केन्द्रक
एउटा अगुणित शुक्राणु र दुई अगुणित ध्रुवीय केन्द्रक

question: Which adaptation is commonly found in intestinal endoparasites?

question: The main nitrogenous waste product excreted by humans is

question: Which animals mainly excrete ammonia as their nitrogenous waste?
question_ne: कुन जनावरहरूले मुख्यतया अमोनियालाई नाइट्रोजनयुक्त फोहोरको रूपमा उत्सर्जन गर्छन्?

question: Birds excrete nitrogenous waste mainly as uric acid because uric acid

Is the most toxic nitrogenous waste

question: Apart from the kidneys, which organ removes excess water and salts from the body through sweat?
question_ne: मिर्गौलाबाहेक कुन अङ्गले पसिनामार्फत शरीरबाट अतिरिक्त पानी र लवणहरू हटाउँछ?
explanation: Sweat glands in the skin release sweat, which contains water, salts and small amounts of urea, helping the body excrete wastes and cool down.

question: Which waste products are removed from the body through the lungs?

explanation: The lungs act as excretory organs by removing carbon dioxide and water vapour from the body during exhalation.

question: The Bohr effect describes the effect of carbon dioxide and hydrogen ions on the
question_ne: बोहर प्रभावले कार्बन डाइअक्साइड र हाइड्रोजन आयनहरूको प्रभाव वर्णन गर्छ
explanation: The Bohr effect is the decrease in haemoglobin's affinity for oxygen when carbon dioxide and hydrogen ion concentration rise, as in active tissues.
explanation_ne: बोहर प्रभाव भनेको कार्बन डाइअक्साइड र हाइड्रोजन आयनको मात्रा बढ्दा हिमोग्लोबिनको अक्सिजनप्रतिको आकर्षण घट्नु हो, जस्तै सक्रिय तन्तुहरूमा हुन्छ।

question: During heavy exercise, the increased carbon dioxide in active muscles causes haemoglobin to
question_ne: कडा व्यायामका बेला सक्रिय मांसपेशीहरूमा बढेको कार्बन डाइअक्साइडले हिमोग्लोबिनलाई
options: Release more oxygen to the tissues
explanation: High carbon dioxide in exercising muscle lowers pH, reducing haemoglobin's affinity for oxygen, so more oxygen is released exactly where it is needed most.
explanation_ne: व्यायाम गर्ने मांसपेशीमा उच्च कार्बन डाइअक्साइडले pH घटाउँछ, जसले हिमोग्लोबिनको अक्सिजनप्रतिको आकर्षण घटाउँछ र सबैभन्दा बढी आवश्यक ठाउँमा बढी अक्सिजन छुट्छ।

question: The Bohr effect shifts the oxygen-haemoglobin dissociation curve to the
question_ne: बोहर प्रभावले अक्सिजन-हिमोग्लोबिन वियोजन वक्रलाई सार्छ
options: It does not shift the curve
explanation: A rightward shift of the dissociation curve means haemoglobin releases oxygen more readily at the same partial pressure — the result of the Bohr effect in active tissues.
explanation_ne: वियोजन वक्रको दायाँतर्फको सर्ने अर्थ हो — हिमोग्लोबिनले उही आंशिक चापमा अक्सिजन सजिलै छोड्छ, जुन सक्रिय तन्तुहरूमा बोहर प्रभावको परिणाम हो।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: A fall in blood pH in respiring tissues leads to
question_ne: श्वसन गरिरहेका तन्तुहरूमा रगतको pH घट्दा
options: Increased affinity of haemoglobin for oxygen
Decreased affinity of haemoglobin for oxygen
Increased oxygen uptake in the lungs only
explanation: Respiring tissues produce carbon dioxide, which forms carbonic acid and lowers pH. The extra hydrogen ions reduce haemoglobin's affinity for oxygen, promoting oxygen release.
explanation_ne: श्वसन गर्ने तन्तुहरूले कार्बन डाइअक्साइड उत्पादन गर्छन्, जसले कार्बोनिक एसिड बनाएर pH घटाउँछ। अतिरिक्त हाइड्रोजन आयनहरूले हिमोग्लोबिनको अक्सिजनप्रतिको आकर्षण घटाउँछन् र अक्सिजन छुटाउन सहयोग गर्छन्।

question: In the lungs, where carbon dioxide concentration is low, the Bohr effect favours
question_ne: फोक्सोमा जहाँ कार्बन डाइअक्साइडको मात्रा कम हुन्छ, बोहर प्रभावले पक्ष लिन्छ
explanation: In the lungs, low carbon dioxide and higher pH increase haemoglobin's affinity for oxygen, so oxygen loads readily onto haemoglobin for transport to the tissues.
explanation_ne: फोक्सोमा कम कार्बन डाइअक्साइड र उच्च pH ले हिमोग्लोबिनको अक्सिजनप्रतिको आकर्षण बढाउँछ, त्यसैले अक्सिजन सजिलै हिमोग्लोबिनमा लोड हुन्छ र तन्तुहरूसम्म पुग्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The chloride shift involves the movement of chloride ions
question_ne: क्लोराइड सिफ्टमा क्लोराइड आयनहरूको गति हुन्छ
options: Into red blood cells in exchange for bicarbonate ions
Out of red blood cells together with sodium ions
From the tissues into the plasma
From the blood into the lungs
explanation: In the chloride shift, chloride ions move into red blood cells from the plasma in exchange for bicarbonate ions moving out.
explanation_ne: क्लोराइड सिफ्टमा क्लोराइड आयनहरू प्लाज्माबाट रातो रक्तकोषभित्र पस्छन् र त्यसको साटो बाइकार्बोनेट आयनहरू बाहिर निस्कन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The chloride shift mainly takes place when blood passes through
question_ne: क्लोराइड सिफ्ट मुख्यतया हुन्छ जब रगत बग्छ
explanation: The chloride shift occurs in the tissues, where carbon dioxide enters the blood and is converted to bicarbonate inside red blood cells.
explanation_ne: क्लोराइड सिफ्ट तन्तुहरूमा हुन्छ, जहाँ कार्बन डाइअक्साइड रगतमा पसेर रातो रक्तकोषभित्र बाइकार्बोनेटमा परिणत हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The main purpose of the chloride shift is to
question_ne: क्लोराइड सिफ्टको मुख्य उद्देश्य हो
options: Increase the oxygen supply to tissues
Maintain electrical balance inside red blood cells
options_ne: रातो रक्तकोषभित्र विद्युतीय सन्तुलन कायम राख्नु
explanation: When bicarbonate ions leave the red blood cell, chloride ions enter to keep the cell electrically neutral, maintaining ionic balance across the membrane.
explanation_ne: बाइकार्बोनेट आयनहरू रातो रक्तकोषबाट बाहिर निस्कँदा क्लोराइड आयनहरू भित्र पसेर कोषलाई विद्युतीय रूपमा तटस्थ राख्छन् र झिल्लीमा आयनिक सन्तुलन कायम गर्छन्।

question: When carbon dioxide enters red blood cells in the tissues, bicarbonate ions move out and chloride ions move in. This exchange is
question_ne: तन्तुहरूमा कार्बन डाइअक्साइड रातो रक्तकोषभित्र पस्दा बाइकार्बोनेट आयनहरू बाहिर निस्कन्छन् र क्लोराइड आयनहरू भित्र पस्छन्। यो आदानप्रदान हो
explanation: The exchange of bicarbonate ions out of red blood cells for chloride ions moving in is the chloride shift. The Bohr effect concerns oxygen release, and the Haldane effect concerns carbon dioxide release in the lungs.
explanation_ne: रातो रक्तकोषबाट बाइकार्बोनेट आयन बाहिर र क्लोराइड आयन भित्र जाने आदानप्रदान नै क्लोराइड सिफ्ट हो। बोहर प्रभाव अक्सिजन छुट्नेसँग र हाल्डेन प्रभाव फोक्सोमा कार्बन डाइअक्साइड छुट्नेसँग सम्बन्धित छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: In the lungs, the chloride shift reverses so that
question_ne: फोक्सोमा क्लोराइड सिफ्ट उल्टिन्छ जसले गर्दा
options: Chloride ions enter red blood cells and oxygen is released
Oxygen leaves the red blood cells rapidly
Bicarbonate ions re-enter red blood cells and carbon dioxide is released
Haemoglobin releases hydrogen ions into the plasma
options_ne: क्लोराइड आयनहरू रातो रक्तकोषभित्र पस्छन् र अक्सिजन छुट्छ
अक्सिजन रातो रक्तकोषबाट छिटो बाहिर निस्कन्छ
बाइकार्बोनेट आयनहरू रातो रक्तकोषभित्र फर्कन्छन् र कार्बन डाइअक्साइड निस्कन्छ

question: In double circulation, blood completes its circuit through the body in
question_ne: दोहोरो परिसंचरणमा रगतले शरीरमा आफ्नो परिक्रमा पूरा गर्छ
explanation: In double circulation blood passes through the heart twice in one complete circuit: once in the pulmonary circuit (to the lungs) and once in the systemic circuit (to the body).

question: The pulmonary circulation carries blood between the heart and the
question_ne: फुफ्फुसीय परिसंचरणले मुटु र कुन अङ्गबीच रगत बोक्छ?

question: In systemic circulation, oxygenated blood is carried to the
question_ne: प्रणालीगत परिसंचरणमा अक्सिजनयुक्त रगत पुर्‍याइन्छ
explanation: Systemic circulation distributes oxygenated blood from the heart to all the tissues of the body and returns deoxygenated blood to the heart.

question: One advantage of double circulation in mammals is that
question_ne: स्तनधारीहरूमा दोहोरो परिसंचरणको एउटा फाइदा हो

Oxygenated and deoxygenated blood remain separate

question: Blood returning from the lungs in the pulmonary veins is

question: The largest part of the human brain, responsible for thinking and memory, is the

question: Balance and coordination of body movements are mainly controlled by the

question: Breathing rate and heartbeat are controlled by the

question: Body temperature and hunger are mainly regulated by the

question: Which class of drugs is routinely given after organ transplantation to prevent rejection of the graft?

question: What is the correct first aid after a venomous snakebite?

question: Which tissue covers body surfaces and lines body cavities and hollow organs?

question: Simple squamous epithelium is best suited for which function?

question: Where is stratified squamous epithelium found in the human body?

question: Epithelial tissue rests on which supporting layer that separates it from the underlying connective tissue?

question: Which type of epithelium lines the trachea and moves mucus upward with tiny hair-like structures?

question: Which substance is produced by the liver and stored in the gall bladder?

question: The liver converts excess ammonia from protein breakdown into which less toxic substance?

question: Which blood vessel carries nutrient-rich blood from the intestines to the liver?

question: The liver stores glucose in the form of which substance?

question: Jean-Baptiste Lamarck proposed his theory of evolution mainly based on which idea?

question: According to Lamarck, the long neck of the giraffe developed because giraffes did what over many generations?

Migrated to areas with tall trees

question: Which statement best describes Lamarck's idea of inheritance of acquired characteristics?

explanation: Lamarck believed characteristics an organism acquires during its lifetime, such as a strengthened muscle, could be inherited by its offspring.

question: Which observation contradicts Lamarck's theory of evolution?

question: Amoebiasis is caused by which protozoan parasite?

question: The nephron is the structural and functional unit of which organ?

question: Filtration of blood in the nephron first takes place in which structure?

question: Which part of the nephron creates the concentration gradient in the kidney medulla that allows concentrated urine to form?

question: Which cup-shaped structure collects the filtrate from the glomerulus?

question: Which part of a neuron receives signals from other neurons?

question: The zygote formed after fertilisation divides by which process to form a ball of cells?
question_ne: निषेचनपछि बनेको जाइगोट कुन प्रक्रियाद्वारा विभाजन भएर कोशिकाहरूको गोलो समूह बन्छ?
explanation: Cleavage is the rapid series of mitotic divisions of the zygote that produces a solid ball of cells (morula) without overall growth.
explanation_ne: क्लिभेज जाइगोटको तीव्र माइटोटिक विभाजनहरूको शृङ्खला हो, जसले समग्र वृद्धि नभई कोशिकाहरूको ठोस गोलो समूह (मोरुला) बनाउँछ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which structure connects the developing foetus to the placenta?
question_ne: कुन संरचनाले विकास हुँदै गरेको भ्रूणलाई सालनाल (प्लेसेन्टा) सँग जोड्छ?
explanation: The umbilical cord links the foetus to the placenta, carrying oxygen and nutrients to the foetus and waste products away from it.
explanation_ne: नाभी नलीले भ्रूणलाई सालनालसँग जोड्छ, जसले भ्रूणसम्म अक्सिजन र पोषक तत्व पुर्‍याउँछ र फोहोर पदार्थ बाहिर लैजान्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: During gastrulation, three germ layers are formed. Which germ layer gives rise to the nervous system?
question_ne: ग्यास्ट्रुलेसनको समयमा तीन जनन तह बन्छन्। कुन जनन तहबाट स्नायु प्रणाली बन्छ?
explanation: The ectoderm (outer germ layer) forms the nervous system and the outer skin; the mesoderm forms muscle and bone, and the endoderm forms the gut lining.
explanation_ne: एक्टोडर्म (बाहिरी जनन तह) बाट स्नायु प्रणाली र बाहिरी छाला बन्छ; मेसोडर्मबाट मांसपेशी र हड्डी, एन्डोडर्मबाट आन्द्राको अस्तर बन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The normal gestation period in humans is about how many weeks?
question_ne: मानिसमा सामान्य गर्भावधि करिब कति हप्ता हुन्छ?
explanation: Human gestation lasts about 40 weeks (around 280 days) from the first day of the last menstrual period to birth.
explanation_ne: मानव गर्भावधि अन्तिम महिनावारीको पहिलो दिनदेखि जन्मसम्म करिब ४० हप्ता (लगभग २८० दिन) हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Urine formed in the kidneys is carried to the urinary bladder through which tubes?
question_ne: मिर्गौलामा बनेको पिसाब कुन नलीहरूबाट मूत्राशयसम्म पुग्छ?
explanation: Each kidney drains through a ureter into the urinary bladder; the urethra then carries urine out of the body.
explanation_ne: प्रत्येक मिर्गौलाबाट मूत्रवाहिनीद्वारा पिसाब मूत्राशयमा जान्छ; मूत्रमार्गले त्यसपछि पिसाब शरीरबाहिर निकाल्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which hormone increases water reabsorption in the collecting ducts of the kidney?
question_ne: कुन हर्मोनले मिर्गौलाका सङ्कलन नलीमा पानीको पुनः अवशोषण बढाउँछ?
explanation: ADH (vasopressin) makes the collecting ducts more permeable to water, so more water is reabsorbed and urine becomes more concentrated.
explanation_ne: ADH (भासोप्रेसिन) ले सङ्कलन नलीलाई पानीका लागि बढी पारगम्य बनाउँछ, जसले बढी पानी पुनः अवशोषण हुन्छ र पिसाब गाढा बन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: In a healthy person, which substance is normally absent from urine?
question_ne: स्वस्थ व्यक्तिमा कुन पदार्थ सामान्यतया पिसाबमा हुँदैन?
explanation: All filtered glucose is normally reabsorbed in the proximal tubule, so healthy urine contains no glucose; glucose in urine suggests diabetes.
explanation_ne: छानिएको सबै ग्लुकोज सामान्यतया निकटस्थ नलीमा पुनः अवशोषण हुन्छ, त्यसैले स्वस्थ पिसाबमा ग्लुकोज हुँदैन; पिसाबमा ग्लुकोज हुनु मधुमेहको सङ्केत हुन सक्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The countercurrent mechanism in the kidney mainly helps the body to produce which type of urine?
question_ne: मिर्गौलाको काउन्टरकरेन्ट संयन्त्रले मुख्य रूपमा शरीरलाई कस्तो पिसाब बनाउन मद्दत गर्छ?
explanation: The countercurrent mechanism builds a salt gradient in the medulla that draws water out of the collecting ducts, allowing the kidney to conserve water by producing concentrated urine.
explanation_ne: काउन्टरकरेन्ट संयन्त्रले मेडुलामा लवण प्रवणता बनाउँछ, जसले सङ्कलन नलीबाट पानी तान्छ र मिर्गौलालाई गाढा पिसाब बनाएर पानी बचाउन दिन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which blood vessels bring blood to the kidney for filtration?
question_ne: कुन रक्तनलीले छान्नका लागि रगत मिर्गौलासम्म ल्याउँछ?
explanation: The renal arteries branch from the aorta and carry oxygenated blood into each kidney; filtered blood leaves through the renal veins.
explanation_ne: मिर्गौलाका धमनी महाधमनीबाट निस्केर अक्सिजनयुक्त रगत प्रत्येक मिर्गौलामा पुर्‍याउँछन्; छानिएको रगत मिर्गौलाका शिराबाट बाहिर निस्कन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: After the bones that fuse during growth have joined, how many bones does an adult skeleton contain?
question_ne: बढ्दै जाँदा जोडिने हड्डीहरू जोडिएपछि वयस्क कङ्कालमा कति वटा हड्डी हुन्छन्?
explanation: An adult human has 206 bones; babies are born with about 300 bones, many of which fuse together as they grow.
explanation_ne: वयस्क मानिसमा २०६ वटा हड्डी हुन्छन्; शिशु करिब ३०० हड्डीसहित जन्मन्छन्, जसमध्ये धेरै बढ्दै जाँदा जोडिन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which bone is the longest and strongest in the human body?
question_ne: मानव शरीरको सबैभन्दा लामो र बलियो हड्डी कुन हो?
explanation: The femur (thigh bone) is the longest and strongest bone in the body, running from the hip to the knee.
explanation_ne: फिमर (तिघ्राको हड्डी) शरीरको सबैभन्दा लामो र बलियो हड्डी हो, जुन कम्मरदेखि घुँडासम्म जान्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The shoulder joint, between the humerus and the scapula, allows movement in many directions. Which type of joint is it?
question_ne: ह्युमरस र स्क्यापुलाबीचको काँधको जोर्नीले धेरै दिशामा चाल दिन्छ। यो कुन प्रकारको जोर्नी हो?
explanation: The shoulder is a ball-and-socket joint: the rounded head of the humerus fits into the socket of the scapula, allowing rotation in many directions.
explanation_ne: काँध बल र सकेट जोर्नी हो: ह्युमरसको गोलो टाउको स्क्यापुलाको सकेटमा फिट हुन्छ, जसले धेरै दिशामा घुम्न दिन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Muscle contraction occurs when which protein filaments slide past each other?
question_ne: मांसपेशी सङ्कुचन कुन प्रोटिन तन्तुहरू एकअर्कामाथि चिप्लिँदा हुन्छ?
explanation: According to the sliding filament theory, myosin heads pull actin filaments toward the centre of the sarcomere, shortening the muscle fibre.
explanation_ne: स्लाइडिङ फिलामेन्ट सिद्धान्तअनुसार मायोसिनका टाउकाले एक्टिन तन्तुलाई सार्कोमियरको केन्द्रतिर तान्छन्, जसले मांसपेशी तन्तु छोटिन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which mineral gives hardness to bones and teeth?
question_ne: कुन खनिजले हड्डी र दाँतलाई कडापन दिन्छ?
explanation: Calcium, deposited mainly as calcium phosphate (hydroxyapatite), gives bones and teeth their hardness and strength.
explanation_ne: क्याल्सियम, मुख्य रूपमा क्याल्सियम फस्फेट (हाइड्रोक्सीएपाटाइट) को रूपमा जम्मा भएर हड्डी र दाँतलाई कडापन र बल दिन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year
